gauge_clock_offset_h.what: best gauge-clock offset from UTC (Earth tide, 15-20 Mar)

tide_dlogL_PST.what: log-likelihood deficit of PST vs best

tide_sign_PST.what: PST fit has the physical sign?

rate_file_offsets_h.what: rate-file minus gauge times of matched events

front_powerlaw.what: stored front r = a (t - t0)^n (m, h): a, t0, n, rms

front_D_4Dt_lsq.what: D from LSQ r = sqrt(4 D (t - t0)) on the stored curve

front_D_4piDt_lsq.what: same curve, paper's printed r = sqrt(4 pi D t)

front_D_endpoint_4Dt.what: r^2/(4t) at the end of the window

dv_within_cell_slope_m_per_h.what: growth of published distance with time inside one 40-m catalogue cell (median of cells)

dv_cells_positive_frac.what: fraction of populated cells with positive slope

dv_resid_sd.what: sd of published distance after cell effects, and after cell + common time effect (m)

catalogue_depth_drift_m_per_h.what: drift of the catalogue's median depth below the injector, with 95% CI

front_growth_required_m.what: growth a D=0.43 front needs over the same span (m)

cycle_loading.what: per-cycle ramp: duration, dp, mean and max dp/dt, rise above prior max

heldout_skill.what: held-out gain per event over a constant rate (loco, slow2fast, fast2slow)

fits_full.what: parameters fitted to all cycles (one configuration)

compare_exp_diffusion.what: held-out dll of exp+diffusion minus each model, 95% block-bootstrap

compare_exp_diffusion_cascade.what: held-out dll of exp+diffusion+cascade minus each model, 95% block-bootstrap

depth_transport.what: transport time per catalogue depth class and implied diffusivity

depth_LR.what: LR test: one transport time for all depths

depth_heldout_dll.what: held-out gain of depth-specific transport times

transport_D_range.what: D (m2/s) for the fitted tau at assumed transport distances L (m)

xcorr_lags.what: model-free lag of seismicity behind gauge pressure, per clock shift and depth class

clockshift_+0.what: transport time and held-out skill if the catalogue clock were gauge + shift

clockshift_+8.what: transport time and held-out skill if the catalogue clock were gauge + shift

clockshift_+7.what: transport time and held-out skill if the catalogue clock were gauge + shift

clockshift_-7.what: transport time and held-out skill if the catalogue clock were gauge + shift

slower_ramps.what: isolated cycle-IV ramp stretched by s: lag, excess events, peak rate (value, jackknife se)

per_cycle_predictive.what: held-out (loco) predictions of each cycle vs observation

convergence_checks.what: profile maxima minus best-fit log-likelihood (must be <= ~0.05); transport time in each leave-one-cycle-out fit
